chunks: And in the narration of Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
If you take land on lease for gold or silver, then do not lease it out for more than what you took it for, because gold and silver are fixed commodities.

key_terms.بِأَكْثَرَ: for a greater amount or higher price
key_terms.بِذَهَبٍ: in exchange for gold as payment
key_terms.تَقَبَّلْتَ: you took on lease or accepted under a lease arrangement
key_terms.تُقَبِّلْهَا: you lease it out or assign it under a lease arrangement
key_terms.فِضَّةٍ: in exchange for silver as payment
key_terms.مُصْمَتَانِ: fixed commodities, not subject here to increase in this arrangement

ai.seo_question: Can land leased for gold or silver be subleased for a higher amount?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding leasing land in exchange for gold or silver. It prohibits subleasing the land for a higher amount when the lease consideration is gold or silver, on the basis that these are fixed monetary commodities.
